title: The open tensor restriction square preserves adjunction units on stalks
statement: Let $k:X'\to X$ be a scheme morphism, $U\subset X$ an open subscheme, $T=X'\times_X U$, and $p:T\to X'$, $q:T\to U$ the projections. Let $M$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $z_0\in T$; put $z=p(z_0)$ and $N=M|_U$. Use the tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], the module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], and the underived comparison $\theta:k^*M|_T\simeq q^*N$ specified by [def-pc-open-restricted-tensor-complex-iso]. For $a:Y\to Z$ and $F$ an $\mathcal O_Z$-module, let $\eta_{a,y,F}:F_{a(y)}\to(a^*F)_y$ be the additive stalk map of the chosen adjunction unit followed by stalkPushforward. Let $r_o:(k^*M)_z\to(k^*M|_T)_{z_0}$ and $r_i:M_{U.\iota(qz_0)}\to N_{qz_0}$ be the inverses of Mathlib's restrictStalkNatIso for $p$ and $U.\iota$. Let $t:M_{kz}\to M_{U.\iota(qz_0)}$ be stalkCongr for the point equality induced by pullback.condition. Then the two additive maps from $M_{kz}$ to $(q^*N)_{z_0}$ agree: $\eta_{k,z,M};r_o;\theta_{z_0}=t;r_i;\eta_{q,z_0,N}$.

proof.text: The private proved helper open_iso_eq identifies openTensorRestrictionIso with the direct comparison of the chosen tensor adjunction and restrictAdjunction, using leftAdjointUniq_inv_app and leftAdjointUniq_trans_app. Therefore open_unit is exactly unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. The helper composition_unit applies unit_conjugateEquiv_symm to the pushforward composition and congruence iso that defines tensorPullbackCompositionIso.

For M, multiply the desired underived sheaf-unit square on the right by the output pushforward composition iso cP. Expand its two open restriction units by open_unit. Cancel the first open comparison against its inverse in openTensorRestrictionSquareIso. Naturality of cP moves the resulting composite comparison past pushforward. Apply composition_unit for (p,k), cancel its tensor composition iso with the inverse, and move the input open comparison through the unit for q by unit_naturality. Naturality of cQ and composition_unit for (q,U.ι) identify the result with the other side. These are the private square_unit calculation; cancellation by cP proves the sheaf morphism square.

Apply openRestriction_stalk_square to the ambient unit a, the restricted unit b, and the open tensor square component c. The sheaf-square hypothesis is the proved square_unit. This gives the asserted additive stalk-unit identity, including the actual inverse restriction coordinates and point transport.

lean.statement:
theorem openTensorRestrictionSquare_stalk_unit
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens)
    (M : X.Modules) (z0 : (pullback k U.ι : Scheme.{u})) :
    let z := pullback.fst k U.ι z0
    let q := pullback.snd k U.ι
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M
    let L0 := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (pullback k U.ι).toRingedSpace z0
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback k U.ι).presheaf.stalk z0)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let hp : k z = U.ι (q z0) :=
      congrArg (fun h : pullback k U.ι ⟶ X ↦ h z0) pullback.condition
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (k z)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf
          ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction k)).unit.app M)) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).obj M).presheaf.stalkPushforward
        AddCommGrpCat.{u} k.base z ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (pullback.fst k U.ι) z0).inv.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).obj M) ≫
      F0.map (L0.map ((openTensorRestrictionSquareIso k U).hom.app M)) =
    (M.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hp)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U.ι (q z0)).inv.app M ≫
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (q z0)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf
          ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction q)).unit.app N)) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj N).presheaf.stalkPushforward
        AddCommGrpCat.{u} q.base z0
